summary: Bail appeal by Union of India against High Court order releasing PFI members; High Court failed to apply UAPA Section 43D standard; 'prima facie case' under UAPA requires broad probabilities, not detailed inquiry; weapon-training allegations (knives, swords, beer-bottle bombing) constitute preparation for terrorist acts under Section 15; reliance on protected witnesses' statements proper; High Court wrongly trivialized evidence; bail improperly granted.
legal_provisions_cited: Gurwinder Singh vs State of Punjab
NIA vs Zahoor Ahmad Shah Watali
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court bail order set aside; respondents to surrender within 7 days.
